issues_encountered_and_fixed.issue: Headless command execution state loss between sequential invocations
issues_encountered_and_fixed.cause: Headless Blender exits after each script without saving main scene state unless instructed
issues_encountered_and_fixed.fix: Enhanced BlenderBridge to maintain persistent `_active_session.blend` and pass `--save-session` flag on every command

issues_encountered_and_fixed.issue: Subprocess WinError 1920 calling blender-launcher.exe from restricted child tokens
issues_encountered_and_fixed.cause: Windows Store AppExecutionAlias reparse points require direct invocation with proper user environment token
issues_encountered_and_fixed.fix: Configured execution runner and path resolution to directly use verified WindowsApps execution alias

issues_encountered_and_fixed.issue: Football Z-axis dimension flattening in initial prototype
issues_encountered_and_fixed.cause: Vertex normalization subtracted an offset relative to world (0, 0, 1.1) when mesh data was already centered at local (0, 0, 0)
issues_encountered_and_fixed.fix: Constructed geometry strictly at origin (0, 0, 0), normalized all 60 vertices radially from local center, then moved object to floor in Object mode

issues_encountered_and_fixed.issue: Re-imported GLTF primitive splitting reported open edges at material borders
issues_encountered_and_fixed.cause: GLTF specification separates multi-material meshes into independent primitive draw calls per material
issues_encountered_and_fixed.fix: Verified that co-located boundary vertices merge by distance with 0 non-manifold edges, confirming 100% watertight underlying geometry
